Subject: Stellar Payments - procurement & PO process follow-up

Hi Sam - great to meet today. Quick recap + proposed next steps from our discovery call: 

1) High-level fit: Redwood Inference looks aligned with Stellar Payments' goals to reduce LLM token costs and get predictable latency for customer-facing fraud workflows. You highlighted throughput at 400-600 qps and delay-sensitive decisions at ~300ms p95.

2) Key decision criteria you called out: predictable latency, SOC 2 evidence, flexible billing (PO/invoice), and a migration path for on-prem/private deployment for regulated flows.

3) Stakeholder map (as I heard it):
   - Economic buyer / procurement: Priya Kumar (Procurement) - responsible for PO, vendor form and preferred payment terms.
   - Legal: Tom Ellis (VP Eng) will own contract review and technical risk signoff.
   - Security: your security analyst (TBD) will want SOC 2 + network/SSO details.
   - Technical: Sam Ortega - product lead driving testing and pilot.

Can you confirm the economic buyer is Priya K. and whether procurement requires a vendor form + net30 by default? Also, who should we send the invoice to (AP contact/email) and do you have a PO number format we should expect?

Attachments: redwood-pricing-quote.pdf (pricing + options) and mutual-action-plan.xlsx (proposed milestones / responsibilities).

Next steps I propose:
- I'll send the SOC 2 summary and security pack to your security contact.
- Loop in our sales manager (rishi_malhotra) on commercial terms for anything outside standard pricing.
- Schedule a short 30-min legal/procurement call next week to walk the procurement checklist. Proposed times: Tue 9/22 10:00-10:30 PT or Wed 9/23 9:00-9:30 PT. Let me know what works.

Thanks - Marissa

Thanks Marissa - good summary. A few answers / clarifications: 

- Yes, Priya Kumar is the procurement lead - I'll loop her in separately (ccing in a follow). Procurement will want: vendor onboarding form, W9, and SOC 2 Type II. Net30 is standard for us but I'll confirm if AP can accept Net45 for pilot spend.
- Billing / AP: please send invoices to ap@stellar-payments.com. PO number format is STLR-YYYY-#### (we'll provide a PO once legal signoff is complete).
- Legal/tech: Tom will do a contract/technical review; he cares about data residency and indemnity language.
- Timeline: we're aiming to have procurement sign-off and a PO issued by end of September (target 2026-09-30) so we can kick off pilot in early October.

Can you send the SOC 2 summary and the sample contract/MSA so Tom can start review? Also, can you confirm whether Redwood needs a signed SOW before issuing a PO or if the PO can be based on the quote + signed MSA?

Sam
